dedupe_keys.name: seismic and energy assessment of the performance of 3d printed concrete structures eries safe 3d printed cs

description: This release measures a single-storey, double-leaf 3D-printed concrete building under biaxial shaking. Version 1.0 contains the initial white-noise test and the lowest-intensity runs of two earthquake records. Accelerometer and displacement channels are sampled at 1000 hertz; optical measurements from 102 markers are sampled at 200 hertz. The dataset is provided by UKCRIC Soil–Foundation–Structure Interaction (SoFSI-Soil Pit) Laboratory through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2025. The provider metadata identifies CSV tables, documentation, plain-text files. Zenodo lists open file access with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. BED currently reports that its dataset download was not found; the separate Zenodo metadata is retained. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models. Sampling resolution is not established here unless stated above; file-level quality remains unverified. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
